name: Maester
what: An open-source PowerShell test framework, built on Pester, that checks Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365 configuration against a library of security tests and produces an HTML report.
when: For recurring configuration checks of a tenant (Conditional Access, Entra settings, Exchange Online), and to catch drift after changes, for example in a scheduled pipeline.
example: Install the Pester version the Maester docs pin (currently `Install-Module Pester -MinimumVersion 5.7.1 -MaximumVersion 5.7.1 -SkipPublisherCheck -Force`), then `Install-Module Maester -Scope CurrentUser`.
Create a test folder and download the tests into it with `Install-MaesterTests`.
Sign in with `Connect-Maester` using an account with read access to the tenant.
Run `Invoke-Maester` and open the HTML report; start with failed tests on Conditional Access and privileged roles.
pitfalls: Some test sets need extra PowerShell modules and roles, for example Exchange Online checks.
A passed test only means that setting matches the test; it is not a full security review.
Keep the tests updated; new checks are added often.
